STEP 7 - Energy: Cooked sausage (pork/beef, smoked style) ≈ 300 kcal per 100 g. 209 g x 3.0 = 627 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Roughly 200 g of sliced sausage on a 20 cm plate is plausible given the visible pile. Energy of ~600 kcal is consistent with that much sausage. This is an estimate; the pile could be somewhat smaller if the slices are thinner than assumed.
